basic_details.scholarship_name: Osaka University SISC MEXT & Honors Graduate Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: Osaka University Graduate School of Science & Graduate School of Information Science and Technology in partnership with MEXT (Japan)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Osaka University (Toyonaka & Suita Campuses, Osaka, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Offered through the Special Integrated Science Course (SISC) and International Physics / Chemistry / Biological Sciences tracks, encompassing Computer Science, Information Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biological Sciences, and Macromolecular Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 25 to 35 fully funded MEXT and Osaka University Fellowship awards allocated per academic year for SISC programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in physics, chemistry, and computing typically receive 3 to 6 fellowship awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master degree; 3 years for PhD degree; 5 years for Integrated PhD program, contingent upon satisfactory annual progress reviews

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries having diplomatic relations with Japan (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Must be born on or after April 2, 1992 for October 2027 enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (Bachelor degree) for Master applicants; completed 18 years of education (Master degree) for Doctoral applicants from an accredited university. Minimum CGPA of 3.40 / 4.00 (or equivalent top 15% rank) and MEXT evaluation score >= 2.30 out of 3.00.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Must achieve a minimum score of 2.30 on the official 3.0-scale MEXT GPA formula evaluated across prior university coursework.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Bachelors or Masters degree in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Science, or closely related fundamental sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final year graduating students eligible; official graduation certificate must be submitted before formal registration in September/October 2027.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of degree conferral.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; demonstrated laboratory research experience and thesis work are primary selection metrics.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT (minimum 80, 88+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0). Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates generally not accepted in lieu of official test scores for MEXT funding nomination.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None required. All lectures, seminars, research discussions, and thesis defense are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; inclusive gender representation actively supported.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Researchers in physical, chemical, biological, and computational sciences.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Japanese government scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full waiver of Osaka University annual tuition fee (JPY 535,800 / year waived completely for all standard degree years).

admission_application_fee.details: 100% full waiver of Osaka University entrance examination fee (JPY 30,000) and admission fee (JPY 282,000 waived completely).

accommodation.details: Priority placement in Osaka University International Student Dormitories (Toyonaka International House, Minoh International House, or Tsukumodai Mansion) for the first year (monthly rent ~JPY 25,000 to JPY 40,000), paid from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid by MEXT: JPY 144,000/month for Master's students; JPY 145,000/month for PhD students (~PKR 265,000/month).

airfare.details: Economy-class round-trip air travel provided by MEXT between applicant's nearest international airport in Pakistan (Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi) and Kansai International Airport (KIX, Osaka).

visa_fee.details: Japanese Student Visa issued free of charge upon presentation of MEXT scholarship certificate and Osaka University Certificate of Eligibility (CoE).

health_insurance.details: Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) monthly premium (~JPY 2,000/month) paid from stipend; covers 70% medical costs, supplemented by university student welfare insurance.

food_allowance.details: Food expenses covered through monthly stipend; subsidized campus cafeterias provide hot meals at JPY 350 - JPY 600 per meal.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Supplied via research laboratory facilities, supercomputer allocations, and departmental consumables budget.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate School of Science research travel grants support attendance at national and international academic symposia.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Osaka monorail and Hankyu train transit costs are self-funded from monthly stipend.

participating_institutions: Osaka University - Toyonaka Campus (Graduate School of Science)
Osaka University - Suita Campus (Graduate School of Information Science and Technology)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 80 global university (QS World #86, top 3 in Japan for natural sciences and physics).
available_majors: Special Integrated Science Course (SISC): Department of Chemistry
Special Integrated Science Course (SISC): Department of Biological Sciences
Special Integrated Science Course (SISC): Department of Macromolecular Science
Graduate School of Information Science and Technology: Computer Science, Information Systems, Multimedia Engineering

university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master program: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD program: 3 years (6 semesters); Integrated PhD: 5 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, or Computer Science with 3.4+ GPA, prospective professor acceptance, research plan, 2 recommendation letters, and IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Information Science & AI and Quantum Physics have severe competition; Biological Sciences and Macromolecular Chemistry offer favorable candidate ratios for qualified experimentalists.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective candidates must review faculty research profiles on the Graduate School of Science website, contact prospective laboratory head, submit academic CV, transcripts, and research outline, and obtain formal consent to supervise before portal submission.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Osaka University SISC Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Explore faculty profiles, contact prospective professor to secure supervisory agreement, then download official application forms from SISC portal and submit electronic dossier.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - October): Review faculty research areas on SISC portal; establish direct contact with preferred research laboratory head.
Step 2 (October - Early November): Secure prospective supervisor's formal agreement to accept candidate and support MEXT nomination.
Step 3 (November - December): Submit formal online application dossier via Osaka University SISC Admissions Portal.
Step 4 (January - February): Departmental screening, document evaluation, and technical video interview conducted by laboratory panel.
Step 5 (March): Osaka University Academic Committee selects top-ranked applicants and forwards nominations to MEXT Headquarters.
Step 6 (June - July): MEXT confirms scholarship awards; Osaka University issues official letter of acceptance and Certificate of Eligibility.
Step 7 (July - August): Apply for Japanese student visa; flight arrangements confirmed by MEXT travel division.
Step 8 (Late September / Early October): Arrival in Osaka; residence registration, bank account setup, and course commencement.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct integrated nomination: Osaka University International Graduate Admissions Office nominates admitted students directly to MEXT.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters: from former academic supervisor and Dean/Department Chair submitted as signed letters.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Research Proposal & Statement of Intent: Describe prior research experience, scientific motivation, proposed experimental methodology, and career vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 1,500 to 2,500 word research proposal detailing hypothesis, experimental methodology, and literature review developed with prospective professor.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing research projects, laboratory techniques, publications, conference presentations, and programming skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Detailed 30 to 45 minute technical interview conducted via Zoom by an examination committee of 3 faculty members evaluating subject knowledge and research plan feasibility.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (minimum 80, 88+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5 overall). GRE Subject test optional but advantageous for physics.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC Pakistan attestation required on both original and photocopy sets of degrees and transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translation for any documents issued in Urdu or other languages.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Digital application submission via email/portal followed by physical mailing of attested documents to Graduate School of Science admissions office.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed official application form downloaded from SISC admissions portal.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure all personal details match Pakistani passport biodata page exactly.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Letter of Preliminary Acceptance from Supervisor
required_documents_checklist.specification: Formal written consent from Osaka University professor agreeing to act as academic advisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Essential prerequisite; applications without supervisor confirmation cannot proceed.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified official academic transcripts and degrees covering all university education.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: HEC Pakistan attestation required on both original and photocopy sets.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 1,500 to 2,500 word research proposal detailing hypothesis, experimental methodology, and literature review.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must demonstrate deep understanding of host laboratory experimental setup and published literature.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed recommendation letters from former professors or thesis advisors who know the applicant's research abilities.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be on institutional letterhead with official email addresses and direct contact numbers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic test report dated within past two years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official electronic score dispatch or verified original scorecard copy.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Abstract of Bachelor or Master Thesis
required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive 1 to 2 page technical abstract of previous thesis or major research project.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight individual contributions, laboratory techniques mastered, and published results.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Prescribed MEXT/Osaka University health examination form completed and signed by an authorized physician.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Can be obtained from any recognized public or tertiary hospital in Pakistan.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Special Integrated Science Course (SISC) admissions run annually for October enrollment under MEXT University Recommendation track.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (CGPA, transcript rigor, class rank, and MEXT GPA score)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (Student leadership, lab teamwork, and community involvement)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Clarity of scientific problem, experimental methodology, lab alignment, and thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Laboratory research assistantships or scientific industry experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of purpose, scientific maturity, and long-range goals)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Referee appraisals of research acumen and work ethic)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 15% (Fundamental scientific knowledge, oral defense, and intellectual agility during video examination)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Admitting Laboratory Head, SISC Departmental Admissions Committee, and Graduate School of Science Dean.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Multistage evaluation: Faculty supervisor agreement, followed by departmental admissions committee assessment of academic records and research proposal, technical oral examination, and institutional nomination to MEXT. Approximately 1:6 applicants shortlisted for oral examination; nominated candidates have over 90% MEXT approval rate.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~300 to 450 international applicants across all science divisions
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~25 to 35 fully funded MEXT and Osaka University Fellowships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~14.0% (Solid success rate for physics, chemistry, and computing scholars)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid background in fundamental sciences or computing, 1+ peer-reviewed journal or conference publications, prior lab research, IELTS 7.0.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from Quaid-i-Azam University, NUST, GCU Lahore, UET, and PIEAS in physics, chemistry, and computing.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, Vietnam, Pakistan, India, South Korea, Indonesia

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized agencies claiming to guarantee MEXT recommendation at Osaka University. Osaka University never works with commercial recruiters.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Osaka University does not charge any application or processing fee for SISC MEXT scholarship applicants. Application is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never use third-party agents; direct scholarly correspondence with professors is strictly evaluated during screening.
hidden_costs_breakdown: First month rent and deposit at university dormitories before first stipend transfer (prepare ~JPY 80,000 to 120,000 in cash; ~PKR 150,000 to 220,000).
Domestic travel costs within Pakistan to reach international departure airport.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Japanese fluency is needed for admission. (FACT: SISC courses and research are conducted completely in English).
CLAIM: Pakistani degrees need prior Japanese embassy authentication. (FACT: Only HEC Pakistan attestation is needed for Osaka University admissions).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some agencies state admissions happen twice a year for SISC MEXT; official guidelines confirm MEXT university recommendation occurs only for the October intake cycle.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain MEXT minimum GPA (>=2.30) and achieve satisfactory progress on doctoral milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus research residency and regular participation in laboratory group seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual academic progress evaluations conducted by supervisory committee and reported to MEXT.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: MEXT recipients are prohibited from taking external jobs; authorized on-campus Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) duties are allowed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Graduates are free to stay in Japan on employment visas or pursue worldwide academic opportunities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero bond or post-graduation return obligations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminates immediately upon withdrawal or disciplinary expulsion; past disbursed funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university while on MEXT recommendation is strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major changes are permitted only within the department and subject to approval by both laboratory heads and the graduate dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master graduates may apply for MEXT extension into the PhD program based on competitive academic and research review.
